info.name: Smart Discharge Planner Service
info.description:
Postman collection for Smart Discharge Planner Service REST API.

This service accepts clinical and operational patient data and returns an AI-generated, structured discharge readiness assessment (readiness status, blockers, medication reconciliation concerns, follow-up considerations, and a draft discharge summary).

The collection includes:
- Health Check
- Plan Discharge (Minimal) — smallest valid payload
- Plan Discharge (Full Example) — every optional field populated with a single representative entry per list
- Plan Discharge (Comprehensive Example) — a realistic, fully-populated multi-condition patient encounter with multiple entries across every list field, plus a saved example response showing the full shape of a real AI-generated discharge plan
- Plan Discharge (Invalid Payload) — demonstrates 422 validation error shape

Each request includes a saved example response under its "Examples" tab in Postman so you can see expected output without needing a live OpenAI-backed server running.

request.description:
A realistic, fully-populated multi-condition patient encounter exercising every field in the request schema with multiple entries per list (7 vitals, 4 pending tests, 3 active problems, 5 current and 6 discharge medications, 4 clinical notes of different types, 4 follow-up appointments across specialties, 5 patient education topics, and 4 equipment needs).

Patient profile: pneumonia with diabetes, hypertension, COPD, and CKD stage 3 comorbidities, improving but with several unresolved discharge blockers (pending cultures, unconfirmed home oxygen, unscheduled specialist follow-up). This is the best example to use for understanding the full range of realistic input the service can accept and reason over.

response.name: Success - Needs Review (comprehensive multi-condition patient)
